title: Random's Wandering Traders
description: Overwrites the wandering trader trades with new and modified trades!
body:
Random's Wandering Traders is a Wandering Trader overwriting datapack that makes the trades more useful and better!

Every time a wandering trader spawns, its current trades are removed and the following trades are randomized:
